Arc is central to this workflow.
Ödeme ve ağ ücreti aynı USDC bakiyesinde: Payment and network fees draw from the same USDC balance. Carpan does not add them as separate assets.
Desteklenen ağlardaki USDC’yi Arc’a geti: Bring USDC to Arc or send it to supported networks. Source transfers and destination delivery have separate evidence.
Giriş ücretsiz mesaj imzasıdır. Ödemeler: Sign-in is a free message signature. Payments require your wallet approval; Carpan never receives your private key.
